items.costNote: 2026–27 reference, not a Fall 2027 quote or full-degree total.
items.costDetail: UT Dallas MBA Cost & Tuition Plan 2026–2027 Estimated Variable Tuition (Full-Time MBA): Nonresident Cost $18,266 Fall I + $18,266 Spring I = $36,532 academic year (matches Bursar Non-Resident/Graduate Variable 2026–27 rate at 12+ SCH). Resident Cost $9,111/semester ($18,222 AY). Separate MBA/program Fees column $1,500 Fall I + $1,700 Spring I = $3,200 AY (MGT supplemental $100/SCH) not included in the $36,532. Published full-program Nonresident Tuition on 53 credits $60,307 + Fees $5,300 = $65,607 — full-duration totals, not used as the annual figure. School states all Full-Time admits get ≥$1,000 merit scholarship qualifying for resident rates; nonresident sticker used per OOS-primary rule. Full-time MBA only — not Professional/Online.

items.costDetail: USC Marshall Full-Time MBA Tuition & Fees based on 2026–2027 rates: First-year Tuition $86,295; Second-year Tuition $78,450. Separate first-year line items: USC Central Services and Health Fees $1,922, MBA Program Fees $3,000, PRIME Fee $3,850, Student Health Insurance $3,988 — first-year published total $99,055 (excludes housing/living). Second-year total $84,481. Rates may rise ~3–5% annually; official USC rates at arr.usc.edu. Full-time MBA only — not IBEAR/part-time.

Mandatory Fees $1,516/Year (plus $100 international student fee when applicable). items.costDetail: WashU Olin Full-Time MBA Cost, Aid and Scholarships (posted Spring 2026) for candidates starting Fall 2026: Tuition $72,700 ($36,350/semester) under Academic Year 2026–27 — equals two flat-rate semesters. Program Fee $900, Student Government Fee $130, Health and Wellness Fee $350 per semester (fees not in the $72,700). Published Total $150,920 ($37,730/semester) is the four-semester / full-program estimate (4 × $36,350 tuition + 4 × $1,380 fees = $150,920), not used as the annual tuition field. Bulletin 2026–27 lists Full-Time MBA $36,350 per semester (four semesters standard). Page note calling the $72,700 'entire program' conflicts with semester math and bulletin; AY figure used. Full-time MBA only — not Flex/EMBA.
